title: Palpitations or unusual pulse
summary: Palpitations or an unusual pulse may be a response to exertion if they coincide with activity, an artifact if the signal is poor, or an arrhythmia that must be ruled out if compatible symptoms are present. The sensor pulse does not replace an ECG. Informational support only: not a diagnosis or a treatment decision. There are no clinical personnel on board: the steps are first aid and monitoring; treatment depends on mission procedures.

notify: mission control (if the link is up)

steps.text: Call for emergency help now using the mission's means (ship alarm, crew, mission control if the link is up). Do not wait to see if it improves.

review.text: Palpitations without warning signs: rest and monitor.
notify: mission control (if the link is up)

steps.text: Try breathing exercises or deep relaxation.
Repeat the pulse measurement at rest with the sensor properly placed.
If loss of consciousness, chest pain, shortness of breath, unusual sweating or dizziness appears, treat it as an emergency.

reading_check.text: Isolated pulse reading with no known symptoms: confirm symptoms and repeat the measurement before interpreting it.
notify: mission control (if the link is up)

steps.text: Repeat the measurement at rest with the sensor properly placed.
Pay attention to how you feel: the number alone neither confirms nor rules out anything.

reading_reference.text: The pulse reading is within the visual reference range. If symptoms appear, describe them here.

steps.text: Watch your symptoms as well as the number.

questions.symptoms_and_repeat: Do you notice palpitations, dizziness, chest pain or shortness of breath now, and were you exercising? Repeat the measurement at rest with the sensor properly placed.

candidates.label: Response to exertion
candidates.minimum_evidence: Palpitations or a high pulse that coincide with reported physical activity.

candidates.label: Measurement artifact
candidates.minimum_evidence: Pulse reading with suspect or poor quality.

candidates.label: Arrhythmia (must be ruled out)
candidates.minimum_evidence: Reported palpitations not explained by exertion, persistent or repeated, or with dizziness.
